entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You don't need to be here right[n]now, do you? Come on, let's head[n]somewhere else!
entries.uk: Тобі ж тут зараз нічого робити, так?[n]Ходімо кудись в інше місце!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What's wrong? Come on, we should[n]go say goodbye to the others!
entries.uk: Що таке? Ну ж бо, треба піти[n]попрощатися з рештою!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, you don't need to do anything[n]here right now, do you? Let's go[n]somewhere else!
entries.uk: Агов, тобі ж зараз нема чого тут[n]робити, правда? Ходімо[n]кудись-інде!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Do you want to train here? That's not[n]really like you though...
entries.uk: Хочеш тут потренуватися? Якось[n]це на тебе не схоже...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Doesn't working out alone in your room[n]sound way cooler?
entries.uk: Хіба качатися на самоті у своїй[n]кімнаті — це не набагато крутіше?

entries.en: I have no reason to go[n]to the gymnasium...
It says it's under maintenance.[n]I don't think it's turned on...
entries.uk: Написано, що він на техобслуговуванні.[n]Не думаю, що він увімкнений...

entries.en: This is the guys' bathroom...
It's far dirtier than the ones[n]in the classroom building...
entries.uk: Тут значно брудніше, ніж[n]у навчальному корпусі...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't you know that's the girls'[n]bathroom? You're not supposed[n]to be in there...
entries.uk: Ти що, не знаєш, що це жіночий[n]туалет? Тобі туди не можна...

entries.en: I don't have a good reason[n]to be in the ladies' restroom...
entries.uk: У мене немає поважної причини[n]заходити до жіночого туалету...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: H-Huh!? Something in there really stinks!
There's a horrid smell[n]wafting from the room...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's a huge projector screen in there...[n]It almost looks like the sail of a ship.
entries.uk: Там величезний проєкційний екран...[n]Майже як вітрило корабля.

entries.en: There's a large projector inside...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I like how all those test tubes are lined[n]up... Doesn't this seem like the perfect[n]place for a smarty like me?
entries.uk: Мені подобається, як рівненько стоять[n]ці пробірки... Хіба це не ідеальне місце[n]для такого розумника, як я?

entries.en: The shelves of the chemistry room[n]are lined with test tubes...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There are all sorts of scientific specimens[n]in there. I hope they don't do any cat[n]dissections...
entries.uk: Там повно всіляких наукових препаратів.[n]Сподіваюся, котів тут[n]не розтинають...

entries.en: There are various specimens[n]decorating the biology room...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This room is so messy...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It looks more like someone's bedroom[n]than an office.

entries.en: The PE faculty office is filled[n]with all sorts of clutter.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: S-Someone's in there!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wait... is that a doll? O-Oh, it's an[n]anatomical model...

entries.en: This is the science preparation room.
I can see the faint outline of an[n]anatomical model in the darkness...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is this a storage room? It looks like[n]it's locked.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What a mess... I don't think these kids[n]really care about art at all.

entries.en: The canvases are all in disarray...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is it okay to leave medicine out in the[n]open like this? Oh, it's empty.

entries.en: It's a turtle... Is this thing a class pet[n]or something?

entries.en: The turtle is trying extremely[n]hard to stretch its neck...
